moments.author: Variety
moments.quote: “The Further Mis‑Adventures of Cliff Booth” is earning rave first reactions for David Fincher, Brad Pitt and Quentin Tarantino, with the film press calling it "wildly entertaining," "an absolute triumph" and "truly one of the year’s best films."
moments.why: It encapsulated the overwhelmingly positive critical energy toward the premiere, quickly becoming widely shared and quoted as a definitive early endorsement of the film.

moments.author: Variety
moments.quote: Brad Pitt says "Ocean's 14" won't start shooting until "late" 2027: “We’re talking about sometime late next year... I tell you, Grant and George, they can write a good script."
moments.why: It generated buzz by countering earlier expectations for a near-term shoot and revived fan anticipation for the long-awaited franchise return.

moments.author: Variety
moments.quote: On Monday night’s episode of “The Daily Show,” Jon Stewart weighed in on Robert Pattinson’s appointment as the next James Bond: “Long story short, they ended up giving the role to f‑‑‑ing Robert Pattinson... Pattinson! You already got Batman. Enough’s enough!”,
moments.why: Stewart’s witty jab struck a humorous note in the immediate public discourse around the casting, turning it into a widely shared meme-worthy moment.
